plan.notes: B.S. Criminal Justice & Criminology, Department of Criminal Justice and Criminology. SEMESTER SYSTEM — all credits are semester hours. Built from the official MSU Denver Criminal Justice & Criminology, B.S. 4-year plan, Fall 2021 catalog year (https://www.msudenver.edu/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/4YR-Plan-Criminal-Justice-Criminology-2021.pdf). Minor is REQUIRED (modeled as student-choice minor slots). Major: CJC 1010/1450/2050/2020/2210/3400/3410/4700 Capstone, plus Tier II Area Electives (5 courses across Corrections, Courts/Law, Police, Admin. of Justice subareas) and Tier III CJC Electives (3 courses, upper-division). General Studies: Written Communication 6cr, Oral Communication 3cr, Quantitative Literacy 3cr, Arts & Humanities 6cr, Historical 3cr, Natural & Physical Sciences 6cr, Social & Behavioral Sciences 6cr. 120 semester credits total.
